Definition: of Hebrew origin (H1296); Barachias (i.e. Berechijah), an Israelite:--Barachias.
BiblicalUsage: Barachias is named once. He is the father of Zacharias, whose righteous blood Jesus says will come upon the generation that rejects Him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a father's name can carry a son's witness, and Zacharias the son of Barachias stands in Jesus' words as one more righteous man slain by those who would not hear.
